brief:
An Israeli airstrike killed one man and wounded several others in an attack on a tent sheltering displaced persons in Asdaa city, in the Mawasi area north of Khanyounis in southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The strike struck the encampment without warning.

Israeli military aircraft conducted the aerial raid on the location housing civilians who had fled their homes. Rescue workers arrived at the scene to assist the wounded following the bombardment.
